preconditions.expression: s is str and p is str
preconditions.description: Both s and p are strings.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in p)
preconditions.description: All characters in s and p are lowercase letters a-z.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (s == '' and p == '') or re.fullmatch(pattern, s)
postconditions.description: The function returns true if the pattern p matches the entire string s, and false otherwise. The pattern is constructed by replacing '*' with '.*' and '?' with '.' in p.
